drafts.summary: Derive Scope Unit ancestry from Declarations
drafts.body:
## Summary

Derive Scope Unit ancestry from Declarations

## Claim

Scope Unit ancestry is derived from the governing structural declarations and their direct parent relations: the Project Scope Unit Declaration and non-Project Scope Delegations. CAPRMEDIO does not author or persist a Structural Level property for a Scope Unit. A displayed path or depth is derived from that parent chain only. It does not establish or override parentage, ownership, or authority. Conflicting or unresolved parent inputs remain unresolved.

change.before: Scope Unit ancestry is derived from Scope Unit Declarations and their direct parent relations.
change.after: Scope Unit ancestry is derived from the governing structural declarations and their direct parent relations: the Project Scope Unit Declaration and non-Project Scope Delegations.

drafts.summary: Derive Scope Unit places from Declarations
drafts.body:
## Summary

Derive Scope Unit places from Declarations

## Claim

Each non-Project Scope Unit within the Project has Authority and Delivery folders derived from its governing Scope Delegation. Delivery Atoms govern representation, placement, and general Carrier conventions without repeating a unit's selected paths.

change.before: Each non-Project Scope Unit has Authority and Delivery folders derived from its Scope Unit Declaration.
change.after: Each non-Project Scope Unit within the Project has Authority and Delivery folders derived from its governing Scope Delegation.

note: Structural-level language and unrelated Clauses preserved; no native edit.
